title: AuthorLensCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='author-lens'. A Lens is the plural-Mishpat governance primitive: one collective's deterministic reading over an EPR, co-valid alongside peer lenses (no collapse). The whole concept lives in payload_json — NO new DHT entry type (the action discriminator distinguishes it), so authoring it is DNA-hash-neutral (coordinator hot-swap). Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type). Storage projection keys the `lenses` table on cid == entry_hash. Canon: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-27-plural-mishpat-lenses-over-epr-design.md (§8). Service-layer slice: genesis/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-27-plural-mishpat-lenses-service-layer-plan.md (S1, I1).

action.description: Action discriminator. Fixed at 'author-lens' for this commitment kind.

governs_epr.description: The EPR SLUG-ID this lens governs (the scope key, e.g. 'epr:lamad-spa') — NOT the dag-cbor EprHead CID. The forward index (lens ← EPR) reuses the existing SQL scope projection (find_active_delegates_compute style) which keys on slug-id everywhere; binding on the CID would line up with no existing scope row. See plan A3.

school.description: The collective / school-of-thought label that authored this reading (e.g. 'georgist', 'beerian', 'limitarian'). Feeds the contributor-card and the affinity attribution. Plural schools over one EPR is the point — they do not collapse.

role.description: Governance role. 'lens' = one school's co-valid reading (affinity-ranked, never authoritative-by-fiat); 'floor'/'ceiling' = constitutional bounds (the wisdom-layer floor/ceiling seam) that bracket what any lens may steer toward.

rule.description: The deterministic predicate over the EPR signal — the 'teeth'. A smart-contract-like rule that fires deterministically when the lens is exercised (e.g. a predicate + the verdict/signal it emits). Shape is school-defined; the substrate only requires it be a structured object so it is machine-evaluable, not prose.

telos.description: What this lens steers toward — its viability and/or justice target (George/Beer: the justice surface and the viability surface). The substrate requires a structured object; the 'summary' is surfaced in the LensBindingView.telosSummary.

summary.description: Short human summary of the steering target (rendered as telosSummary in the lens-market view).

version_parent.description: CID (entry_hash) of the superseded lens this one replaces, or null for a first-version lens. Commitments are immutable, so lens versioning is a new create + this back-pointer (never an update). Forms the immutable version chain.
